name: Annular-ring 3R: open-bore thin-section rings at every joint axis
verdict: screened: best honest gap 57.81 (k52, Bench(60,160) fast cache, K3 march, K2 dense, K6, audit clean) vs 68.93 baseline and 65.05 for its own O20 twin at q 1.0. But the open bore loses to the O20 hub at every joint and every bore (rings at all three: 91.6-112.0 vs 69.29); the gain is the skin-contoured skirt under the J1 ring (98.5 % in band), which the champion can take too. Not worth a GPU sweep of ring sizes; worth one short sweep of the champion with a J1 skirt.
limiter: J2 and the links, measured: hub 2 sits at 161 mm from GH (0 % in band), link 1 / link 2 0.2 / 1 % in band at q 1.0 - the 3R proximity limit, which rings do not touch. Ring levels (mm along the axis): J1 hub 54 vs ring 58/100/109/117 for bore 12.7/19.05/25.4/31.75 (trapezius/neck rises medially); J2 105 vs 112-118 (the axis wanders over scapula and trunk); J3 66 vs 68 (a real dome, but the flat rim floats: in-band 0.19-0.37 vs 0.60). Red team k52: across the body (plane 150, elev 120, axial -60) the trapezius rises into the J1 bore (wall -0.4 mm); overhead 6/17 lost (3 closure, 3 part-part); behind the back 5/20 lost to closure margin.
note: Kit model; per-joint O20 twin as the in-model control (all-hub twin reproduces the kit template's 69.29). Strap roots at rim + 2 mm lug at the race level as 3-D points (two passes); ring partner zone for K6 = outer radius + lug + 2 mm; bore/outer walls and skirt walls checked for contact. Spec correction: champion A2 is 66.75, not 81.45. Variant: skirt = lower race housing extended to the skin as a contoured 2 mm shell in the proximal frame.
